scope: Self-describing over-bound refusal error variant resolving the M7 review condition C5: an over-bound payload refusal now surfaces as OwnerBridgeError::Kernel(kernel::Error::OverBound) (display "kernel: OverBound") instead of the opaque Kernel(NativeRefusal). New owners::Error::OverBound variant returned by the owners bound() helper for over-limit sizes, and a new kernel::Error::OverBound variant appended after Busy so every pre-existing abi_code() is unchanged. The sim encode/decode/decode_owner codec helpers and the wand_ports bound() return OverBound for over-limit payloads; structural count/overflow limits (owner slots, counters, publication revision/epoch, domain count limits) keep Error::Limit. Every native-port refusal mapping maps OverBound through: runtime.rs native_refusal plus the seven transport-local native_refusal/native_refusal_step pairs (action_time, movement_actions, monster_ticks, inventory_actions, item_effects, services, traversal). Kernel limits unchanged; goldens frozen.
